# Data Lineage — stitched_student_master_v4

**Generated by**: `etl/stitch_v4.py`  
**Validated by**: `data/processed/validate_stitched_v4.py`  
**Master population**: 1,200 synthetic master students (`MSTU00001` – `MSTU01200`)  
**Bridge tables**: `dim_cs_skills_reference.csv` (180 rows), `fact_subject_marks_reference.csv` (382 rows)

---

## 1. Source File Inventory

| File | Rows | ID namespace | Role |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fact_risk_training.csv` | 1,200 | `STU####` (4-digit) | **Spine** — all 1,200 rows become master students 1:1 |
| `dim_cs_skills.csv` | 180 | `STU#####` (5-digit, **different namespace**) | Bridge table only (`dim_cs_skills_reference`) |
| `subject_marks_linked.csv` | 382 | `UCI_####` | Bridge table only (`fact_subject_marks_reference`) |
| `student_placement_prediction_dataset_2026.csv` | 100,000 | integer | Attribute-matched onto spine (Join 1) |
| `college_student_placement_dataset.csv` | 10,000 | `CLG####` | Attribute-matched onto spine (Join 2) |
| `data_science_student_marks.csv` | 497 | integer | Attribute-matched onto spine, CS/IT students only (Join 3) |
| `scores.csv` | 200 | **none** | Skill-score-band matched onto spine (Join 4) |
| `stitched_student_master_v3_gpa10.csv` | 5,000 | `STU#####` (old synthetic) | **Reference only** — used to identify v3 defects; NOT a data source |

---

## 2. Column-Level Lineage — stitched_student_master_v4.csv

### 2.1 Identity

| Column | Source | Logic |
|---|---|---|
| `master_student_id` | Synthetic | Sequential MSTU00001…MSTU01200. Prefix unique to this file — cannot collide with any source ID namespace. |
| `src_risk_training_id` | `fact_risk_training` → `student_id` | Retained as audit trail. Original STU#### 4-digit format. |

### 2.2 Demographics (from fact_risk_training, direct carry-over)

`year_class`, `program_stream`, `age`, `gender`

### 2.3 Academic Standing (from fact_risk_training)

| Column | Notes |
|---|---|
| `cgpa_category` | Ordinal band (e.g., "7.0–8.4"). This is the ONLY GPA representation in master — see §3 Issue (a). |
| `academic_satisfaction` | Survey Likert response |
| `attendance_percentage` | Same column name exists in placement_2026 — **dropped from Join 1** to prevent duplication. |

### 2.4 Study Behaviour (from fact_risk_training, direct carry-over)

`study_hours_daily`, `daily_productivity`, `revision_frequency`, `focus_duration`,
`study_consistency`, `tasks_on_time`, `preparation_status`, `assignments_on_time`,
`sleep_hours`, `screen_time_non_study`, `main_distractor`, `sleepy_during_study`,
`energy_level`, `stress_level`, `routine_rating`

> `sleep_hours` and `study_hours_per_day` also present in `placement_2026` — both **dropped from Join 1**.

### 2.5 Career & Motivation (from fact_risk_training, direct carry-over)

`career_goal_clarity`, `career_interest`, `skills_developing`, `online_courses`,
`projects_internships`, `programming_foundation`, `events_participation`,
`strongest_asset`, `internal_barrier`, `external_resources`, `external_pressure`

### 2.6 Risk Label

| Column | Source | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `performance_risk_level` | `fact_risk_training` | Target label: Low / Moderate / High Risk |

### 2.7 Placement & Career Skills — Join 1

**Source**: `student_placement_prediction_dataset_2026.csv`  
**Match key**: `cgpa_band × branch_group × gender` (probabilistic; with replacement)  
**Flag**: `is_synthetic_placement_match = True` for all 1,200 rows

Columns: `coding_skill_score`, `aptitude_score`, `communication_skill_score`,
`logical_reasoning_score`, `hackathons_participated`, `github_repos`,
`linkedin_connections`, `mock_interview_score`, `internships_count`,
`projects_count`, `certifications_count`, `extracurricular_score`,
`leadership_score`, `volunteer_experience`, `backlogs`, `college_tier`,
`placement_status`, `salary_package_lpa`

**Dropped before join** (duplicates with spine): `student_id`, `age`, `gender`, `cgpa`,
`sleep_hours`, `study_hours_per_day`, `attendance_percentage`

### 2.8 College Profile — Join 2

**Source**: `college_student_placement_dataset.csv`  
**Match key**: `cgpa_band × placement_key` (probabilistic; with replacement)  
**Flag**: `is_synthetic_college_match = True` for all 1,200 rows

| Column | Source col | Note |
|---|---|---|
| `iq_score` | `IQ` | 41–158 |
| `prev_sem_result` | `Prev_Sem_Result` | GPA 5.0–10.0 |
| `academic_performance_score` | `Academic_Performance` | 1–10 |
| `clg_extracurricular_score` | `Extra_Curricular_Score` | `clg_` prefix to distinguish from Join 1's `extracurricular_score` |
| `clg_communication_skills` | `Communication_Skills` | `clg_` prefix to distinguish from Join 1's `communication_skill_score` |
| `clg_projects_completed` | `Projects_Completed` | `clg_` prefix; correlation with `projects_count` confirmed < 0.95 |

### 2.9 DS Subject Marks — Join 3

**Source**: `data_science_student_marks.csv`  
**Match key**: `age_band`  
**Eligibility**: `program_stream ∈ {BCA, BSc CS, BSc IT, BSc Cyber Security}` — 991/1,200 students  
**Non-CS students**: NaN for all 5 columns  
**Flag**: `is_synthetic_ds_marks_match = True/False`

Columns (all `ds_` prefixed to distinguish from Join 4 skill scores):
`ds_sql_marks`, `ds_excel_marks`, `ds_python_marks`, `ds_power_bi_marks`, `ds_english_marks`

**Dropped before join**: `student_id` (non-overlapping integer), `location` (not analytic), `age` (in spine)

### 2.10 Tool Skill Scores — Join 4

**Source**: `scores.csv` (no IDs, no demographics)  
**Match key**: Python score quintile × SQL score quintile, mapped to `coding_skill_score`
and `logical_reasoning_score` quintiles from Join 1  
**Flag**: `is_synthetic_scores_match = True` for all 1,200 rows

Columns: `skill_score_python`, `skill_score_sql`, `skill_score_ml`,
`skill_score_tableau`, `skill_score_excel` (all 0.0–1.0 scale)

Note: `Student Placed` column from scores.csv **not carried** — `placement_status` (Join 1) is authoritative.

### 2.11 Bridge Foreign Keys

| Column | References | Nullable |
|---|---|---|
| `cs_ref_id` | `dim_cs_skills_reference.cs_ref_id` | Yes — null for non-CS streams |
| `uci_ref_id` | `fact_subject_marks_reference.uci_ref_id` | Yes — null for students age > 22 |

### 2.12 Synthetic Match Flags

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `is_synthetic_placement_match` | Always True — placement_2026 join is always probabilistic |
| `is_synthetic_college_match` | Always True — college_placement join is always probabilistic |
| `is_synthetic_ds_marks_match` | True where DS marks attached; False + NaN DS cols for non-CS |
| `is_synthetic_scores_match` | Always True — scores.csv join is always probabilistic |
| `cs_ref_assigned` | True where cs_ref_id assigned; False + null cs_ref_id for non-CS |
| `is_synthetic_subject_match` | True where uci_ref_id assigned (age ≤ 22); False elsewhere |

## 3. Columns Dropped from v3 Master — Defect Resolution

| v3 Column | Issue | Resolution |
|---|---|---|
| `previous_gpa` | **Issue (a)**: GPA on 4.0 scale, duplicated as `Previous_GPA_10` | Dropped. Single GPA representation is `cgpa_category` (ordinal band). |
| `Previous_GPA_10` | **Issue (a)**: correlation 0.99999 with `previous_gpa × 2.5` | Dropped. |
| `career_field` | **Issue (b)**: 100% identical to `major` in v3 | Dropped. `program_stream` is the stream field; `interested_domain` + `future_career` live only in the CS bridge table. |
| `career_gpa` | **Issue (c)**: correlation −0.01 to −0.02 — invented noise column | Dropped entirely. No analogue in v4. |
| `g1_mat`, `g2_mat`, `g3_mat`, `g1_por`, `g2_por`, `g3_por` (inline) | **Issue (d)**: silent recycling of 382 UCI rows across 5,000 master rows | Moved to `fact_subject_marks_reference.csv` bridge with `uci_ref_id` PK. Master carries nullable FK only for eligible students (age ≤ 22), flagged `is_synthetic_subject_match`. |
| `subject_marks_student_id` | **Issue (d)**: recycled UCI_#### ID embedded as if 1:1 | Replaced by nullable `uci_ref_id` FK with explicit NaN for ineligible students. |

---

## 4. ID Namespace Safety

| Namespace | Example | Used In | Collides With Master? |
|---|---|---|---|
| `MSTU#####` | `MSTU00001` | Master only | N/A (new prefix) |
| `STU####` (4-digit) | `STU0001` | `fact_risk_training` → `src_risk_training_id` | No — stored as metadata only |
| `STU#####` (5-digit) | `STU03651` | `dim_cs_skills` → `dim_cs_skills_reference.src_student_id` | No — isolated in bridge |
| `UCI_####` | `UCI_0001` | `subject_marks_linked` → `fact_subject_marks_reference.uci_ref_id` | No — isolated in bridge |
| `CLG####` | `CLG0030` | `college_student_placement_dataset` | No — ID not carried to master |
| Integer | `1`, `2`, … | `placement_2026`, `data_science_student_marks` | No — IDs not carried to master |

> **v3 Issue (e) resolved**: The 5-digit `STU#####` namespace from `dim_cs_skills` overlapped numerically with the old synthetic master's IDs but referred to different real-world students. In v4 the master uses `MSTU#####` exclusively, and the CS skills file is isolated in its own bridge table.

---

## 5. Join Logic Summary

| Join | Source | Match key | Rows matched | Flag |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Spine | `fact_risk_training` | 1:1 identity | 1,200 | — |
| Join 1 | `placement_2026` | `cgpa_band × branch_group × gender` | 1,200 (with replacement) | `is_synthetic_placement_match` |
| Join 2 | `college_placement` | `cgpa_band × placement_key` | 1,200 (with replacement) | `is_synthetic_college_match` |
| Join 3 | `ds_marks` | `age_band` (CS/IT only) | 991 matched; 209 → NaN | `is_synthetic_ds_marks_match` |
| Join 4 | `scores` | `python_quintile × sql_quintile` | 1,200 (with replacement) | `is_synthetic_scores_match` |
| CS FK | `dim_cs_skills_reference` | `domain_group × python_skill_enc` | 991 CS-stream students | `cs_ref_assigned` |
| UCI FK | `fact_subject_marks_reference` | `age_band × study_hours_band` | 942 students age ≤ 22 | `is_synthetic_subject_match` |
